gloss: overinvolvement; excessive meddling; being too controlling

definitions.gloss: overinvolvement; excessive interference; being too controlling
definitions.explanation: Interfering too much in someone else's affairs, especially a parent being overly controlling of their child. A common topic in discussions about parenting and relationships.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過干渉|かかんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm struggling with my parents' overinvolvement.

examples.japanese: {過干渉|かかんしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げる→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧。
examples.english: Being too controlling hinders a child's independence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{過干渉|かかんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I understand wanting to worry, but I'm careful not to become too controlling.

notes:
Compound of {過|か} (excessive) + ⟦{干渉|かんしょう}→干渉：12445_kanshou⟧ (interference, meddling). Most commonly used in the context of parent-child relationships, but can apply to any relationship where one party interferes too much.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過干渉|かかんしょう}: parental overinvolvement
- {過干渉|かかんしょう}な⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: an overbearing parent
- {過干渉|かかんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: to avoid being too controlling
- {過干渉|かかんしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過保護|かほご}→過保護：14748_kahogo⟧: overcontrol and overprotection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{過保護|かほご}→過保護：14748_kahogo⟧: overprotection — shielding too much rather than controlling
- ⟦{干渉|かんしょう}→干渉：12445_kanshou⟧: interference — the neutral base word without the "excessive" prefix
- おせっかい: meddlesome, nosy — more colloquial, broader context

CULTURAL NOTE:
{過干渉|かかんしょう} is a frequent topic in Japanese parenting discussions, self-help books, and psychology. It is often contrasted with ⟦{過保護|かほご}→過保護：14748_kahogo⟧ (overprotective) and ⟦{放任|ほうにん}→放任：19119_hounin⟧ (laissez-faire, hands-off parenting).
